summary.plain: A planned detector with a silicon-sensor target that stops the pions and a large calorimeter around it that measures the decay positrons.
summary.technical: Planned detector: LGAD active target, 3pi sr 25-radiation-length calorimeter (LXe or LYSO), high-speed readout.

technology.quote: an active target using Low Gain Avalanche Detectors (LGAD) combined with a calorimeter using liquid noble gas (Xenon) or LYSO crystals
technology.value: Active target using Low Gain Avalanche Detectors combined with a calorimeter using liquid xenon or LYSO crystals
